title: Error-Prone AI Accessibility Tools Reportedly Lead to Navigation Issues for Blind Internet Users

behaviors.text: AI-powered accessibility overlays on websites frequently mislabel or misinterpret content, in turn complicating navigation for blind users and others with disabilities.
Users report that the AI tools interfere with screen readers and mislead them with inaccurate descriptions.
The reported unreliability in these tools have prompted legal action, as the companies behind them seek compliance with accessibility laws.
